C 무효/동일/이하이면 두 번째 lap 없이 기본 비율. secondLap 또는 confirmed/reference 가격경계 충족 시 subdued yellow; 가격경계는 inclusive에 따라 >= 또는 >. 추가 용량 input-L / C-L 안내를 tooltip과 aria-label에 표시하며 자동 압축/전체 용량 비율은 원래 input/L 및 input/C로 별도 표시(100% 넘어도 tooltip은 비율을 유지). tests: disabled lap 경계 599999/600000/800000/1000000/1200000와 활성 상태; invalid fallback; 실시간 설정 100->50%; 테마/고대비 CSS. 테스트 실행 안 함.

guides.base:
# Read-only code investigation

Answer both questions using the fixed project snapshot. Report implementation evidence and relevant tests, distinguish confirmed behavior from uncertainty, and cite file names and symbols or lines. Do not modify or execute the investigated scripts.

Q1. 자동 컨텍스트 압축을 끈 상태에서 컨텍스트 게이지는 어떤 분모와 경계로 진행률을 계산하나요? 색상·추가 용량 안내·잘못된 값 처리와 관련 검증 근거도 설명하세요.

Q2. 관리 실행기를 선택할 때 앱 실행기 영수증이 없거나 손상되면 어떻게 되나요? 환경변수 지정·실행파일 identity 검사·기존 실행기 fallback과 관련 검증 근거도 설명하세요.

Use files/search to locate owners and read_file for the needed source ranges. Choose the evidence needed to answer; there is no requirement to read whole files.

Only read this guide and use the client for all source queries. No direct shell/source/report/helper/adapter/runtime reads, internet, other lanes or delegation. You share the workspace; preserve all concurrent work. All source is a read-only Windows x64 JS/TS snapshot. Do not force the answer to favor a tool. Expand evidence when a concrete gap remains. No file/line/character budget is imposed.

Common API: files({glob?:fnmatch_glob}) returns snapshot source paths; '*' may match '/'. search({pattern:rg_regex,relative_path?:file_or_dir,glob?:rg_glob,context?:nonnegative_integer}) runs rg with line numbers; no match is normal. read_file({relative_path:file,start_line?:1_based,end_line?:inclusive}) returns only requested lines with 1-based labels and preserves source line endings. Omitted range means whole file. 
This condition does not expose list_ids/read_symbols; do not call them.

PowerShell UTF-8 request (ONE JSON per invocation):

```powershell
$OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
```
